description: WHAT: List all 52 ikeytz Einsatzgebiete on maps.ikeytz.com as point cards (slug, name, plz, lat/lng, embed_map, geo_api, grenze_api, punkt_api) — not polygons. Also public Sammel: /api/v1/embed/orte · /orte/grenzen · /orte/punkte. RETURNS items[], count, total, offset, limit. Optional fields= comma filter; limit/offset page the list. USE to enumerate the service area or build a picker. DOES NOT return OSM boundaries in the list (use get_grenze or GET grenze_api per slug) or prices. NEXT: get_service_area, get_embed_map, get_grenze, find_by_plz.

fields.description: Optional field filter: comma-separated names or array. Keeps envelope keys (ok, tool, summary, canonicalUrl, attribution, locale, related, count, total, offset, limit, compact) plus listed fields. Example: slug,name,plz,lat,lng.

limit.description: Maximum items or lines to return after offset. Omit = all remaining in the window (subject to tool-specific clamps). For geo near-search default is often 5 without radius_km, up to 52 with radius.

locale.description: maps is German-only (de). Omit or pass de. Other values are ignored; URLs stay https://maps.ikeytz.com/… with no locale prefix. Not a www multi-locale switch — use @ikeytz/mcp list_locales on www for en|fr|ru|fa|ar|tr.

offset.description: 0-based index into a list or discovery file lines (split on \n). 0 = first. Omit = 0. Combine with limit to page. Use nextOffset / offset+limit from a previous result when present.

name: list_service_areas
title: List Service Areas
